name: zzAU1_exposure_live

tests.name: both terms can be read back before anything is changed
the wardrobe is open through the founder's own SWITCH SKIN button
the preview window has painted and reports where it is
the two terms this job found were put back
Relay OG was put back on the Dog, and it went back
every rung set the exposure it asked for, and the figure held the glow throughout

detail.note: BOTH ENDS. The exposure is the term being swept, so its cvar is read back; the glow is the term being HELD, so what the figure WEARS is read back. Reading only the cvar is what let a whole sweep run against a knob that was refusing every value.

tests.name: the exposure ladder produced more than one picture

detail.note: THE CONTROL THAT WOULD HAVE CAUGHT THE GLOW TOLERANCE. Several rungs and one picture is a knob refusing its values, and it looks exactly like a term that does not matter. If this fails, nothing below is a finding about exposure.
